text: Experiment 56 showed that two patterns on the copper are real: five of six doubled letters in one column at width 7, and pairs of letters 21 apart repeating eleven times.
Each recipe enciphered 4,000 stretches of Carter's book and K1 to K3, and the experiment counted how often each pattern came out as strong as on the copper.
Ciphertext autokey at distance 21 makes the repeats 5.5% of the time, against well under 1% for most recipes, but nothing made both patterns together, and nothing makes the width-7 column.
